text: 国家统计局：生猪产能综合调控政策效应显现，叠加部分地区高温、强降雨等极端天气频发推高运输成本等因素，猪肉价格由上月环比下降0.8%转为上涨4.1%，影响CPI环比上涨约0.07个百分点。
text_en: NBS: The effects of comprehensive policy regulation on hog production capacity have emerged, compounded by frequent extreme weather such as high temperatures and heavy rain in some regions raising transport costs, pork prices turned from a 0.8% month-on-month decline in the previous month to a 4.1% increase, contributing about 0.07 percentage points to the month-on-month CPI increase.
